prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless grayscale height/bump texture for a WebGL modelling-clay shader
Input images: Image 1 shows the current PBD render whose surface is too smooth and shiny; Image 2 is the target clay material reference, especially its softly dappled handmade surface and faint fingerprints; Image 3 concerns colour fusion and is not relevant to this texture
Primary request: create a square, seamlessly tileable grayscale height map of hand-kneaded modelling clay, suitable for perturbing normals on a deforming mesh
Style/medium: neutral technical height texture, not a rendered object or photograph
Composition/framing: flat orthographic texture filling the entire square, uniform detail distribution, exact seamless continuation across left/right and top/bottom edges
Materials/textures: a restrained mixture of broad shallow dimples and low-frequency hand-smoothed unevenness, faint curved fingerprint ridges, tiny compressed pores, and subtle kneading marks; preserve the soft tactile quality seen on the blue and orange clay in Image 2
Color palette: middle gray base; gently lighter raised areas and gently darker depressions; low contrast with no pure white or pure black
Lighting: none baked into the map; no directional highlight, shadow, vignette, or ambient occlusion
Constraints: height data only; no sphere, ball, scene, floor, perspective, color, text, logo, watermark, border, seams, obvious repeating motif, cracks, stone, leather, fabric, wrinkles, or glossy reflections; keep fingerprints sparse and subtle rather than covering the whole surface
